rationale: First reservoir-computing entry in the registry. Default-shot W4 NARROW MISS (42.9% WR, 4pp shy of 47% regime floor, +16.4% ann, 8.6% DD, n=21) plus W6 +23.7% ann — only ESN family member with an alive thr-sweep on 4/7 windows and the genuinely orthogonal non-gradient inductive bias the loop hasn't explored. Train mode single-lever order: readout_C ∈ [0.1, 10] first (LR regularization, 'readout_C' is the only knob that can move the bear-WR floor without disturbing the reservoir's frozen dynamics), then spectral_radius ∈ [0.7, 1.2] (reservoir richness — beware sr>1.0 destabilizes the leaky integrator), then pos_class_weight ∈ [1.0, 2.0]. Skip units (encode is wall-time-bounded at 300) and density (0.1 already gives the canonical sparse-reservoir prior).
